name: JellyTTV
description: Displays Twitch live streams in Jellyfin via native Home Screen Sections and Plugin Pages integration.
overview: Companion plugin for JellyTTV that integrates Twitch live streams into Jellyfin using native Home Screen Sections and Plugin Pages. Requires the Home Screen Sections and Plugin Pages plugins.

versions.changelog: v0.3.1 — Fixes the Twitch page showing "no one is live": Jellyfin serialises plugin responses in PascalCase, so the page's snake_case field reads were all undefined. Property names are now pinned with [JsonPropertyName] and the page tolerates any casing. The 'Live on Twitch' home section now returns real Live TV channel items, restoring artwork and in-app playback and fixing the homepage occasionally collapsing to the default layout with broken scrolling. Automatic guide refresh now runs Jellyfin's Refresh Guide task in-process via ITaskManager instead of an unauthenticated HTTP call that returned 401 — no Jellyfin API key is required.

v0.3.0 — Breaking architecture change: replaced DOM injection with native Home Screen Sections and Plugin Pages integration. Requires HSS and Plugin Pages plugins. Removed API key, sidebar link, and notifications settings. Fixed JSON snake_case deserialization, live thumbnail placeholder bug, and Test Connection staged error reporting. Added avatar fallback for thumbnails and cache-busting for live preview images.
Fix script injection, add AllowAnonymous, add /Config endpoint, fix Test Connection, fix disable/uninstall hang, support Jellyfin 10.11.x.
